items.title: Retrospect your agents
items.summary: Your agent setup is a system, and so are you. Most of us tune the first and ignore the second. This talk treats working with coding agents like a team running retrospectives: collect what happened, find where each problem should have been caught, act on the setup or on your own habits, and check whether the fix held. Based on retros from three real projects, including one where cutting the setup back was the improvement. The appendix has the prompts I use to run my own retros.code.talks 2026, Hamburg
